about_the_game:
Open Island Exorcist RPG

After an earthquake, monsters from folklore roam a quiet island

just off the coast of modern Japan.

But the legendary exorcist maiden Miko from the past is here to battle them!

Take control of her and restore peace to the island!

(While not the whole world, the island is open for you to explore!)

Miko may have forgotten a few things during her long, long sleep,

but there's nothing like some intense fighting to shake up her memory.

So what do we got?

Featuring side-view battles with moving sprites!

Chop-up enemies with a deadly chainsaw and unleash hell with a blazing flamethrower!

Explore the island as you want!

The portable toilets(portaloos) help with fast travel!

Fishing! Farming! Industry?!

Catch fish, grow vegetables, domesticate wild boars and chickens, and even build your own factory!

A story of new encounters, partings, and adventure.

Why was the legendary exorcist maiden sealed? Why have monsters resurfaced?

This story is by no means a tearjerker, but playing through to the end is sure to leave you with a warm feeling in your heart.

  • Fishing! Farming! Livestock! Even factories!

  • Earn skill points to unlock new abilities

  • Craft and upgrade weapons and armor, and fuse accessories

  • Explore the island freely — go wherever you like!

  • Adjustable difficulty settings

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: 3+ GHz Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: 3+ GHz Processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
